debate.said: Here is the case for owning UniCredit. Earnings changed +27.5% versus a year ago. Operating margin is 63.8%. It trades at 8.3x forward earnings.
I'm not convinced. MACD is negative and falling: momentum is deteriorating. Annualised volatility is 32%.
Price action is noise over a few weeks; the business is what we own — earnings changed +27.5% versus a year ago. Weakness can be an entry point.

risk: Maximum position size: 14% of the portfolio (scaled for 32% volatility).
Every order costs a €1 fee, like on Trade Republic. Stop-loss rule: review at -15% from cost.
chair: Weighted committee score is +0.39 on a scale of -1 to +1; 4 of 5 analysts lean the same way. Conviction: High.
Decision: STRONG BUY. We propose a position of up to 14% of the portfolio.
